results.name: Happy purchase over MCP: full mandate chain to a verified Receipt
results.expected: Order paid; merchant-signed Receipt verifies independently

results.name: Happy purchase over REST: same chain, same Receipt, the ACP door
results.expected: Order paid; merchant-signed Receipt verifies independently

results.name: Multi-item Cart mandate: two tees and a cap in one immutable cart
results.expected: Cart totals 3097.00 in integer paise; Order paid with Receipt

results.name: Client-custody purchase: the buyer signs every mandate locally
results.expected: Server never holds the key; locally signed chain reaches paid + Receipt

results.name: Unregistered agent over MCP: a commerce call with a bogus token
results.expected: UNREGISTERED_AGENT Refusal; no mandate ever declared

results.name: Unregistered agent over REST: bogus bearer token on /acp/intents
results.expected: UNREGISTERED_AGENT Refusal, identical shape to the MCP face

results.name: Over-Budget over MCP: the cart exceeds the Intent it chains to
results.expected: OVER_BUDGET Refusal at submit_payment, recoverable

results.name: Over-Budget over REST: same Refusal through the ACP door
results.expected: OVER_BUDGET Refusal at POST /acp/payments, recoverable

results.name: Over-Cap over MCP: a second purchase would breach the registration Cap
results.expected: First purchase paid; second refuses OVER_CAP, not recoverable

results.name: Over-Cap over REST: a single cart bigger than the declared Cap
results.expected: OVER_CAP Refusal before any gateway contact

results.name: Out of stock mid-cart: a rival buys the shelf between cart and payment
results.expected: OUT_OF_STOCK Refusal at submit_payment — nothing was reserved

results.name: Price change between cart and payment, then recovery at the new price
results.expected: PRICE_CHANGED Refusal; re-running create_cart recovers

results.name: Price change over REST: the pinned price hash fails closed
results.expected: PRICE_CHANGED Refusal at POST /acp/payments

results.name: Second purchase on a consumed Intent over MCP (the chain is 1:1:1)
results.expected: INTENT_CONSUMED Refusal for the second cart under one Intent

results.name: Second purchase on a consumed Intent over REST
results.expected: INTENT_CONSUMED Refusal through the ACP door

results.name: Refusal parity: the same policy no is byte-identical on both faces
results.expected: OVER_BUDGET Refusal payloads deep-equal across MCP and REST

results.name: Replayed Payment mandate over MCP: same key, same cart, one charge
results.expected: Retry returns the original Order and link; exactly one payment

results.name: Replayed Payment mandate over REST: the Idempotency-Key header honored
results.expected: Retry replays the original result; no second charge

results.name: Reused idempotency key with a different cart over MCP
results.expected: IDEMPOTENCY_REUSE Refusal — never answers for a cart the buyer did not submit

results.name: Reused idempotency key with a different cart over REST
results.expected: IDEMPOTENCY_REUSE Refusal through the ACP door

results.name: Malformed mandate over MCP: an Intent signature over different bytes
results.expected: INVALID_MANDATE Refusal before the mandate is stored

results.name: Tampered Cart mandate: the agent signs a cart with an altered total
results.expected: INVALID_MANDATE Refusal at the trust gate; zero rows persisted

results.name: Malformed mandate over REST: same forged Intent through the ACP door
results.expected: INVALID_MANDATE Refusal, identical shape to the MCP face

results.name: Payment against a cart hash that names nothing
results.expected: CART_NOT_FOUND validation error — a bad reference, never a Refusal

results.name: Ambiguous query: the want never resolves to a sellable Variant
results.expected: VARIANT_NOT_FOUND validation error at create_cart

results.name: Registration with a Cap of zero paise
results.expected: INVALID_CAP validation error; no Agent minted

results.name: Intent with a non-positive Budget
results.expected: INVALID_BUDGET validation error; no Intent mandate declared

results.name: Decline, bounded retry, fail closed: two gateway declines cancel the Order
results.expected: Order cancelled with a structured Decline; zero charge; no Receipt

results.name: Decline, then the bounded retry succeeds
results.expected: One decline recorded; the retry captures; Order paid with Receipt

results.name: Oversell and automatic refund: two faces race for the last unit
results.expected: MCP buyer fulfilled; REST buyer auto-refunded with a linked refund receipt
